text:
Ava: quick thread to align on pilot acceptance criteria for the batch-signal pilot (batching + caching + quant recommendations + eval alerts). aiming for a gated launch to a handful of customers.
Jamal: direct ask from solutions: they want clear pass/fail criteria and a rollback plan. can we keep criteria lightweight?
Liam: agree on lightweight. propose three gates: accuracy/regression, econ (cost per 1M tokens), and ops (false-positive alert rate).
Priya: from pilots i've seen customers tolerate small perf regressions if cost drops >25% and reliability is steady.
Marta: marketing needs a simple blurb: "reduces token spend while preserving quality" — so we should decide min quality SLA.
Ava: draft acceptance thresholds i propose: 
- regression_delta <= 1.5% absolute on core prompt set (precision@1 baseline)
- cost_reduction >= 20% on customer workload simulation
- eval_alert_fp_rate <= 2% (per day, per 10k evals)
Liam: add a min sample size check: at least 1k eval pairs per window, otherwise gate stays closed.
Nikos: for stats we should run paired t-test and report confidence intervals. prefer non-parametric if distributions skewed.
Priya: ops question — how will alerts surface and who is paged? we need a fallthrough model.
Ava: idea: two-tier alerting: 
- soft alert -> slack channel + ticket (PM/SE) if metric crosses soft threshold
- hard alert -> oncall page + auto-fallback to safe model variant if hard threshold breached for 15m
Jamal: fallback plan needs to be fast. recommend implementing feature flag with model variant mapping and a 5m cool-down between rollbacks.
Liam: sample config we can use for pilot (will be surfaced in console):
```json
{
  "eval_metric": "precision@1",
  "soft_threshold_pct": 3,
  "hard_threshold_pct": 5,
  "min_samples": 1000,
  "soft_window": "30m",
  "hard_window": "15m",
  "fallback_action": "route-to-stable-model",
  "notify": ["pm_team", "solutions"]
}
```
Marta: +1 to two-tier alerts. can we include a human review step before marketing comms?
Ava: yes — gating requires PM sign-off after pilot metrics meet thresholds. also require SE confirmation no regressions on customer-specific anchor prompts.
Priya: rollout plan suggestion: 
1) run closed simulation on customer traces (2 weeks)
2) opt-in pilot with 3 customers (2 small, 1 mid-market) for 4 weeks
3) evaluate metrics + SE reviews -> PM sign-off -> 10% gradual ramp
Jamal: what are launch success metrics post-ramp? propose sustained cost reduction >= 18% and user-facing latency impact <= +10ms p50.
Liam: can we instrument a delta dashboard: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, avg batch size, cache hit rate, and eval_metric trend?
Nikos: i'll own the dashboard and inject synthetic probes to validate cache behavior.
Ava: risks: 
- eval-trigger noise generating pager fatigue
- model quantization causing edge-case hallucinations
- batching introducing tail latency spikes under certain request mixes
We need mitigation plans for each.
Priya: mitigation quick notes: 
- noise -> require min_samples and run smoothing + manual review before paging
- quantization -> limited to non-critical routes initially; opt-out flag for customers
- tail latency -> slot-based throttling and per-customer concurrency limits
Jamal: action items: 
- Liam: produce simulation runbook + config (due in 3 business days)
- Nikos: dashboard + synthetic probes (due EOW)
- Priya: customer pilot list + comms template (due EOW)
- Marta: marketing placeholder copy for "pilot" stage (due next Tue)
- Ava: write final acceptance doc and gating checklist (due next Wed)
deploy-bot: scheduled job "pilot-sim-run" started 2051236900, estimated duration 2h
Ava: thanks all — can we reconvene Thurs 10am to review simulation outputs?
Liam: ok for me.
Priya: yep.
Marta: fine.
Jamal: noted.
Nikos: confirmed.
